title: 第两千六百五十七章黑龙战圣龙第两千六百五十六章高寒仙
slug: 开局成为首座签到极道帝兵
lines: 因果骰子最终定格在数字五上。
数字五对应的正是霸主级一步。
华云飞、红颜、古惊鸿几人看向天命无极，此次出战的正是他。
“要我为你加油打气不？”华云飞笑道。
“不是不行。”天命无极淡淡一笑，挥了挥手，潇洒自信的踏步前行，“走了。”
陈安张了张嘴，又想说“加油”。
可一想起前两次给司马天和纳兰凌霄加油两人都输了，他就觉得自己这句话有点臭，不如不说。
“相信他。”华云飞看向他。
陈安这才点头，看向天命无极，说道：“加油！”
天命无极点头：“会的。”
天命无极的出现引起了无数惊呼。
他的人气一如既往的高。
不止年轻一辈信任他，就连老一辈强者都对他寄予厚望。
黑龙族的年轻大人，龙祖传人，无论哪个身份都足够恐怖。
可以说，天命无极就是黑龙族的未来！
放眼古今未来，天命无极的天赋与实力都能排在前列，而这还是众人不太了解的他。
这一次，他们将亲眼目睹天命无极的战斗，传说中的年轻大人有多恐怖马上就能看到了！
天命无极这一战也是众人所认为的最有希望获胜的一战。
由他出战第三战，三十三天将有极大概率断掉连败！
“渺小的黑龙族竟也能称霸三十三天吗？”
敖楚歌的声音响起，他自界外虚无而来，脚踏龙皇步，背负圣龙图腾，无比的夺目耀眼，气息极尽可怕，让所有人变色。
“天命无极的对手竟也是一条龙？！”
这一幕让所有人呼吸急促。
这一战竟是双龙争霸？
“那图腾是圣龙？可相比于我们知道的圣龙族，此人背后的圣龙图腾可怕了何止百倍？血脉浓度完全不是一个层级的！”
“我都感觉自身命格被压制了，面对这圣龙，不属同族，竟也会被天生压制吗？”
混沌世界中的众人齐齐色变，敖楚歌刚刚出现就让他们的信心动摇了。
没人能想到天命无极的对手竟然也是龙，还是一条圣龙！
按照三十三天的常理，圣龙和黑龙是天生不对付的，而按照古史记载，圣龙一族才是龙族原本的皇者，是所有龙族的统治者。
只是三十三天的黑龙族发生了蜕变，比众人认知中的黑龙族强大了不知多少，这才推翻了过往，坐上了龙族统治者的位子。
圣龙族三十三天也有，不过相比于传说中的龙族统治者，三十三天的圣龙族弱小了很多，并不如传闻中那般强大。
眼前的圣龙族强者显然不一般，背后图腾夺目，代表着他背后的圣龙族正是最辉煌的时候！
“黑龙战圣龙吗？”
华云飞、古惊鸿、楚惊澜和战无不胜几人也来了兴致，这可不是轻易就能见到的，连他们都好奇谁更强。
敖楚歌能够看出不是一般人，脚下的龙皇步是由无数被他屠杀的龙族冤魂和本源凝聚而成，其中就有黑龙的冤魂和本源！
可见被此人屠杀的龙族已经不计其数！
“圣龙吗？”
天命无极自己都很意外。
他也没想到自己的对手会是龙族，更是传说中的龙族统治者——圣龙族！
“我与你印象中的圣龙族可不一样，我来自至高圣龙族，圣龙族中的皇者！”
content_en:
The causal dice finally settled on the number five.
The number five corresponds to the overlord level step.
Hua Yunfei, Hongyan, and Gu Jinghong looked at Tianming Wuji. It was him who was going to fight this time.
"Want me to cheer you up?" Hua Yunfei said with a smile.
"It's not impossible." Tianming Wuji smiled lightly, waved his hand, and walked forward confidently, "Let's go."
Chen An opened his mouth and wanted to say "come on".
But when he remembered that the previous two times he cheered for Sima Tian and Nalan Lingxiao, both of whom had lost, he felt that his words were a bit stinky, so he might as well not say them.
"Believe him." Hua Yunfei looked at him.
Chen An then nodded, looked at Tianming Wuji, and said, "Come on!"
Tianming Wuji nodded: "Yes."
The appearance of Tianming Wuji caused countless exclamations.
His popularity is as high as ever.
Not only the younger generation trusts him, but even the older generation of strong men have high hopes for him.
The young master of the Black Dragon Clan, the descendant of the Dragon Ancestor, is terrifying enough no matter who he is.
It can be said that Tianming Wuji is the future of the Black Dragon Clan!
Looking at the past, present and future, Tianming Wuji's talent and strength can be ranked at the forefront, and this is something that everyone doesn't know much about.
This time, they will witness the battle of Tianming Wuji with their own eyes, and they will soon see how terrifying the legendary young adult is!
The battle of Destiny Wuji is also the battle that everyone thinks is the most promising to win.
If he takes part in the third game, there will be a high probability of breaking the losing streak in the thirty-three days!
"Can the tiny Black Dragon Clan actually dominate the Thirty-Three Heavens?"
Ao Chuge's voice sounded. He came from the void outside the world, stepped on the Dragon King's steps, and carried the Holy Dragon Totem on his back. He was extremely dazzling and his aura was extremely terrifying, making everyone change their color.
"The opponent of Destiny Wuji is also a dragon?!"
This scene made everyone breathless.
Is this battle actually a battle between two dragons?
"That totem is the Holy Dragon? But compared to the Holy Dragon clan we know, the Holy Dragon totem behind this person is more than a hundred times more terrifying? The blood concentration is not at the same level at all!"
"I feel like my fate has been suppressed. Facing this holy dragon, even if I don't belong to the same race, will I be suppressed by nature?"
Everyone in the chaotic world changed their expressions, and their confidence was shaken as soon as Ao Chuge appeared.
No one could have imagined that Destiny Wuji’s opponent was also a dragon, a holy dragon!
According to the common sense of the Thirty-three Heavens, the Holy Dragon and the Black Dragon are inherently incompatible. According to ancient historical records, the Holy Dragon clan is the original emperor of the dragon clan and the ruler of all dragon clans.
It was only in the thirty-three days that the Black Dragon Clan underwent a transformation and became much more powerful than the Black Dragon Clan everyone knew. Only then did they overturn the past and take the position of ruler of the Dragon Clan.
There are also thirty-three holy dragon tribes, but compared to the legendary dragon rulers, the thirty-three holy dragon tribes are much weaker and not as powerful as the rumors say.
The strong man of the Holy Dragon Clan in front of him is obviously extraordinary, and the eye-catching totem behind him means that the Holy Dragon Clan behind him is at its most glorious time!
"The black dragon fights the holy dragon?"
Hua Yunfei, Gu Jinghong, Chu Jinglan and Zhan Wuwei were also interested. This was not easy to see. Even they were curious about who was stronger.
Ao Chuge could tell that he was not an ordinary person. The Dragon King Steps under his feet were condensed from countless wronged souls and origins of the dragon clan that he had slaughtered, including the wronged souls and origins of the black dragon!
It can be seen that countless dragons have been slaughtered by this person!
"Holy dragon?"
Tianming Wuji himself was surprised.
He also didn't expect that his opponent would be the Dragon Clan, and even the legendary ruler of the Dragon Clan - the Holy Dragon Clan!
"I am different from the Holy Dragon Clan in your impression. I come from the Supreme Holy Dragon Clan, the emperor of the Holy Dragon Clan!"
